name: Okazaki Rin
source:
17? years old.
Hobby: Reading, Horse Riding
Favorite Food: The food his butler Tachibana makes.

A mysterious transfer student.
He's smart and good at sports, but he has a weak body.
He knows a certain truth that the protagonist doesn't even know.
